Name: Simple Bags and Baskets
Author: arjan3004
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45590/45590-1777458476-1288817417.png[/img]

This mod adds various bags baskets and other containers to the game. Left click with container in your hand to open them. Additionally when spacecore is installed you can use a keyboard shortcut to open them when you put them in a spacecore slot.

[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45590/45590-1778531130-1169276544.png[/img] HandBag[/b]
You can put almost anything in this bag, however the space is a bit limited. Good for storing a lot of small items.
Size is configurable with Generic Mod Config Menu, 
[i]Sold at Pierre[/i]

[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45590/45590-1778531115-498646121.png[/img]SeedBag[/b]
Can hold a large amount of seeds
[i]Sold at Pierre[/i]

[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45590/45590-1778531118-1068127306.png[/img] TackleBox[/b]
Can hold tackles bait and some other fish related items.
[i]Sold at Willy[/i]

[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45590/45590-1778531127-404065128.png[/img] Cooler
[/b]Can hold food fish fruit and vegetables.
[i]Sold at the saloon[/i]

[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45590/45590-1778531127-379240123.png[/img] Gems
[/b]Can hold all minerals.
[i]Sold at Clint's[/i]

[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45590/45590-1778531118-936452630.png[/img] Keepsakes Box
[/b]Can hold 1 item per slot for items to donate to the museum, 
[i]Rewarded after donating items[/i]

[b][img]data:image/png;base64,[/img] Woven
[/b]Can hold forgeable items and seeds, 
[i]Can be crafted using fibre.[/i]

[b][img]data:image/png;base64,[/img] Trashcan
[/b]Can hold trash,
[i]Can be found ... in the trash[/i]

[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45590/45590-1778531122-623114069.png[/img] Inception
[/b]Can hold other bags and baskets, 
[i]Sold at Mr. Qi[/i]

[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45590/45590-1778531122-326846203.png[/img] Junimo
[/b]Portable version of the junimo chest, 
[i]Sold at Mr. Qi[/i]

[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45590/45590-1778531115-1676009839.png[/img] Linked
[/b]Left click a chest to link this bag to it, 
[i]Sold at  Mr. Qi[/i]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45590/45590-1777458531-704335170.png[/img]
Should be compatible with almost everything, might conflict with mods that alter chest or interface logic.

If you encounter issues with modded items losing (item attachment) data or want to have no limit to the stack size of items in bags set `UseCustomInventoryLogic` in the config to false.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45590/45590-1777458528-344947652.png[/img]
[b]Custom Containers[/b]
[spoiler]In order for a custom item to be registered as a basket it should contain the following ModData:
[code]"EternalSoap.BasketMod.CP.BasketType":"<BasketName>"[/code]For examples take a look in [CP] BasketMod/data/baskets
You can define the items a basket accepts using an extended version of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Context_tags]Context Tags[/url] with an additional or (||) operator.[/spoiler]

[b]Console Commands[/b]
[spoiler][b]Opens a basket with ID:[/b]
basket_open <id> [slotCapacity] [itemCapacity] [stackCapacity] [query]

[b]List all the global inventories that are still stored in the save data:[/b]
bakset_list_inventories

[b]Keeps track of items added to baskets in case something goes wrong:
[/b]basket_recover[/spoiler]
